From August 26 to August 30, 2019, a representative of the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials
Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Pipeline Safety (OPS), pursuant to Chapter 601 of 49
United States Code (U.S.C.), inspected Coffeyville Resources’ (CVR) records for Control Room
Management (CRM) in Houston, Texas.
At the time of the inspection, CVR assets were determined to be operated by a third party control
room identified as the Remote Operations Center (ROC). Since the time of the inspection, ROC
had been acquired two times by different companies: From July 22, 2019 to October 1, 2021,
LineStar Integrity Services, LLC; and from October 1, 2021 to present Everline Automation. At
